description_en: Enables or disables the integration of a cloud service
description_zh: 开启或关闭指定云产品的集成状态
kebab_example: aliyun config update-integrated-service-status --service-code bpstudio --status true --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIntegratedServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The identity of the cloud service that is integrated with Cloud Config. Valid values:

eventbridge: EventBridge
cms: CloudMonitor
bpstudio: Cloud Architect Design Tools
parameters.help_zh:
集成的云服务标识。取值：

eventbridge：事件总线。
cms：云监控。
bpstudio：云速搭
parameters.name: service_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether you want the product to be integrated. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的集成状态。取值：
true：开启。  
false：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The types of the integrated events. Separate multiple event types with commas (,). Valid values:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: resource change event
NonCompliantNotification: non-compliance event
parameters.help_zh:
集成的事件类型，多个事件类型用半角逗号（,）分隔。支持的事件类型有：

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：资源变更事件。
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件
parameters.name: integrated_types

parameters.help_en:
The type of the event that is integrated across accounts. Valid values:

NonCompliantNotification: non-compliance event
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号集成的事件类型。支持的事件类型有：
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件
parameters.name: aggregator_delivery_data_type
